## What you want to do

The task, in a sentence or two. Who writes the program (a developer, an end user of your app)?

## How you would write it

```minab
// The program you would like to write.
```

## What you do today

The workaround, if there is one.

## Notes

Minab 1.x keeps every valid program working (see `docs/compatibility.md`). A change to the
language goes through a proposal, an example and an approval before it is built.
